text:
### Scenario 5: Deceased Customer (Address Change After Death)  
**Situation:** Executor or family member requests address change for deceased customer's account  
**Process:**
- This is account MANAGEMENT, not address change
- Route to probate/estate team
- Requires death certificate
- Account may be frozen during estate settlement
- Not covered by standard address change SOP
- Escalate to Head of Operations  
---
name: Chunk 40/52

raw_entities.name: Deceased Customer Account Management
raw_entities.description: A specialized process for managing accounts of deceased customers, triggered when an executor or family member requests address changes or account modifications. The process involves routing to the probate/estate team, requiring death certificate verification, and potentially freezing the account during estate settlement. This process is distinct from standard address change procedures and requires escalation to senior management.
context: Executor or family member requests address change for deceased customer's account
Route to probate/estate team
Requires death certificate
Account may be frozen during estate settlement
Not covered by standard address change SOP
Escalate to Head of Operations

raw_entities.name: Death Certificate Collection
raw_entities.description: A mandatory step in the deceased customer account management process where the executor or family member must provide a death certificate as evidence of the customer's death. This document is required before any account modifications or estate settlement procedures can proceed.
context: Requires death certificate

raw_entities.name: Probate Team Routing
raw_entities.description: The step in which the deceased customer account case is routed to the probate/estate team for specialized handling. This ensures the account is managed according to estate settlement procedures rather than standard banking operations.
context: Route to probate/estate team

raw_entities.name: Account Freeze During Estate Settlement
raw_entities.description: A procedural step where the deceased customer's account may be frozen to prevent unauthorized transactions during the estate settlement period. This protective measure is applied pending completion of probate procedures and executor authorization.
context: Account may be frozen during estate settlement

raw_entities.name: Escalation to Head of Operations
raw_entities.description: The final escalation step in the deceased customer account management process, where the case is elevated to the Head of Operations for senior-level review and authorization. This ensures appropriate governance and authority for account modifications involving deceased customers.
context: Escalate to Head of Operations

raw_entities.name: Probate/Estate Team
raw_entities.description: The specialized team responsible for managing accounts of deceased customers and overseeing estate settlement procedures. This team handles probate-related account modifications and ensures compliance with estate law requirements.
context: Route to probate/estate team

raw_entities.name: Head of Operations
raw_entities.description: The senior management role responsible for final approval and escalation decisions in deceased customer account management cases. The Head of Operations provides executive oversight for complex estate settlement matters.
context: Escalate to Head of Operations

raw_entities.name: Executor or Family Member
raw_entities.description: The authorized representative of the deceased customer's estate who initiates requests for account modifications, such as address changes. This role is responsible for providing required documentation including the death certificate.
context: Executor or family member requests address change for deceased customer's account

raw_entities.name: Standard Address Change SOP Applicability
raw_entities.description: A decision gate that determines whether a request can be processed under the standard address change procedure or must be escalated to the deceased customer account management process. Requests involving deceased customers are routed out of the standard SOP.
context: Not covered by standard address change SOP

raw_entities.description: An official death certificate required as evidence of the customer's death in the deceased customer account management process. This document must be provided by the executor or family member before account modifications can proceed.
context: Requires death certificate

raw_entities.description: A request to update the address on a deceased customer's account, typically initiated by an executor or family member. This type of address change is not covered by standard procedures and requires specialized probate team handling.
context: Executor or family member requests address change for deceased customer's account

raw_entities.description: A customer account belonging to a deceased individual that is subject to special management procedures during estate settlement. The account may be frozen and is managed by the probate/estate team rather than standard operations.
